criteria.commensurate: Unprofiled cost: seed 39 +0.3 s on a 2.5 s map (10hh) and +1.2 s on 10.3 s (40hh). The reference total is -2.9% and every size is within +2.6%. For a fix that saved more than 5 s on seed 4 and lets Audit-10/20 draw, that size would be proportionate, but only once the explanation owns it
criteria.necessary: Not established. The fix itself (privy slides toward its own end only) is necessary: it removed a band-3 16.3 -> 1.5 s web cost on seed 4. But seed 39's crossing at 10hh (homesteads 1.6 -> 2.35 s cProfile) and its hinterland growth at 40hh (3.0 -> 4.1 s) arrive with that fix. They come from the changed privy placement making the track-out connector sweep work harder, not from any rule the explanation names, and the explanation does not acknowledge them. Wave 56's seat rule does account for +1.1 s cProfile of homesteads at 40hh, and that rule was asked for (rows 580/582/583)
criteria.no_way_around: Probably not. At the fix, the growth is in connector_track -> _fabric_hits, which calls _crosses_fabric once per fabric polygon per candidate (42 sweeps, 13488 calls), and the fabric does not change during the sweep. That is the static-geometry per-candidate scan in dev/performance.md. Prefiltering the fabric once per sweep (cached poly boxes or an STRtree) looks like a cheaper way that has not been tried. What would settle it: a re-explanation attributing seed 39 to the fix's track-out cost, plus a measurement of _fabric_hits with fabric boxes hoisted out of the sweep
